title: Dr's Alts Dashboard
tagline: Adapt an existing BTC maximalist dashboard to a DeFi dashboard on Hardware.
description: As an opportunity to build and try the Emulated DrRobertK's CryptoDashBoard, I took the call on solving a small bug and morph the code to adapt available onchain data from a public Eth Wallet file. I then bought a Raspberry pi 4 and a Hyperpixel 4.0 to build the device that would render the code.
how_its_made: This project use a python program with different source of Apis, notably DeFiPulse and Etherscan. I took several program to mend them in one python file. Once the program is run, It takes control of the screen and displays on a black background, several live informations on the Ethereum Blockchain and your Account.
